{{Quote|Artoo, make sure you watch our credits." <br /> "My grandpa always told me 'Don't watch your credits; watch your health'. So while I was watching my health, someone stole my credits!|[[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and Droogan|<ref name="Evil Plans">{{TCW|Evil Plans}}</ref>}}
'''Droogan''' was a [[Khramboan/Legends|Khramboan]] vendor on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

==Biography==
He swindled [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] out of thirty two [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] when the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was shopping for [[Jogan fruit/Legends|jogan fruit]]. He first stated it was four credits, then sixteen credits, before finally settling on thirty two. During his haggling, Droogan relayed a supposed saying of his [[Droogan's grandfather/Legends|grandfather]] by telling C-3PO to watch his health, not his credits.

==Behind the scenes==
Droogan was voiced by [[Kevin Michael Richardson]]. Richardson also voiced [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]] in the same episode.
